name: Eicher Motors Limited
summary: Eicher Motors Limited, an automobile company, engages in the manufacture and sale of motorcycles and commercial vehicles in India and internationally. The company designs, develops, manufactures, assembles, and sells two-wheelers, as well as related parts and accessories; motorcycle accessories; protective and performance gears; and lifestyle apparel products and accessories. It also provides motorcycle accessories; protective and performance gears; lifestyle apparel products and accessories; and parts and service support for riders across markets.
